name: mg_b034_bank00_shift_b01e_data_stub
summary: Shifts an entry in bank-0 table 0xB01E left by one bit before hitting unparsed data (bank-6 audio stub alias).

name: mg_b034_bank00_check_equip_flags_stub
summary: Inspects equipment flags in zero-page 0x75 and returns without side effects in C output.

name: mg_b034_try_spawn_alert_guard_checked
summary: Validates actor slot bounds, empty slot state, and active alert flag before falling into room guard spawning.

name: mg_b034_hud_copy_padded_name_to_queue
summary: Copies a length-prefixed HUD item or weapon string via zero-page 0x80 into the 0x0740 VRAM queue and zero-pads to 15 bytes.

name: mg_b034_hud_init_vram_queue_header
summary: Initializes the VRAM transfer queue header for a horizontal status-bar write to PPU nametable page 0x23.

name: mg_b034_hud_write_bcd_digit_tile
summary: Formats a single BCD digit into tile 0x70+digit in the VRAM queue while suppressing leading zeroes.

name: mg_b034_update_screen_shake_effect
summary: Toggles PPU Y-scroll and player sprite X offset every 8 frames to produce screen shake until step counter wraps to zero.

name: mg_b034_update_hazard_damage_and_fx
summary: Ticks periodic player health drain, places 4 hazard sprite coordinates from bank-0 tables, and cycles effect tiles 0x90/0x91.

name: mg_b034_vram_cursor_add_offset
summary: Adds an 8-bit unsigned offset to the 16-bit big-endian PPU address cursor in zero-page 0x8D and 0x8E.

name: mg_b034_vram_queue_terminate_at
summary: Writes a zero end-of-queue sentinel at the specified offset in the 0x0740 VRAM transfer queue.

name: mg_b034_clear_room_tiles_and_queue_vram
summary: Zeroes a horizontal or vertical run of room layout tiles in 0x0400 and appends the matching clear command to the VRAM queue.

name: mg_b034_update_bridge_platforms_and_fall_check
summary: Animates 6 moving bridge platform slots and triggers a fatal pitfall transition to room 5 if the player is outside safe bounds.

name: mg_b034_tick_countdown_timer_and_hud
summary: Decrements the 16-bit countdown timer in 0x07D7-0x07D8 every 4 frames, formats 4 decimal HUD tiles at PPU 0x232D, or zeroes health at timeout.

name: mg_b034_set_timer_state_67
summary: Stores the given timer or cutscene phase value into zero-page variable 0x67.

name: mg_b034_spawn_alert_guard_in_room
summary: Loads an alert-reinforcement guard position for the active room from 0xA7C4 into the actor pool and triggers alert audio.

name: mg_b034_hud_refresh_equip_and_ammo
summary: Alternately queues the equipped weapon or item label and its 3-digit BCD ammo count into the bottom status-bar VRAM queue.

name: mg_b034_update_hazard_and_restore_bank6
summary: Runs the bank-0 hazard damage and effect update routine and switches UNROM back to PRG bank 6.

name: mg_b034_restore_bank6_trampoline
summary: Restores UNROM PRG bank 6 via unrom_select_bank_index after bank-0 room handler execution.

name: mg_b034_clear_rect_room_tiles_and_queue
summary: Queues 4 border-clearing runs and clears matching tiles in 0x0400 for an expanding blast area sized by zero-page 0x8F.

name: mg_b034_tick_countdown_and_restore_bank6
summary: Ticks the countdown timer and HUD update routine and restores UNROM PRG bank 6.

name: mg_b034_update_boss_vertical_hover_fx
summary: Cycles actor sprite 0 between 0x92 and 0x93, oscillates its Y coordinate via state counter 0x55, and plays SFX 0x30 at turnaround points.

name: mg_b034_check_laser_or_blast_player_hit
summary: Tests active hazard bounding boxes against the player's coordinates, applying instant death, triggering cutscene state in room 0xBD, or starting blast timers.

name: mg_b034_update_random_hazard_spawns
summary: Selects a pseudo-random hazard pattern index from the frame counter and executes pattern-based hazard spawning and collision checks.

name: mg_b034_update_pattern_hazard_spawns
summary: Places room hazard sprites from table 0xB890, checks the player hitbox overlap to trigger alert alarm SFX 0x49, or spawns an alert guard.

name: mg_b034_update_bridge_and_restore_bank6
summary: Updates the moving bridge platforms and pitfall check and restores UNROM PRG bank 6.

name: mg_b034_check_room_hazard_zones_and_hits
summary: Checks the player against room hazard rectangles in table 0xBAA7 to deal periodic damage and detects projectile type 0x29 hits to clear hazard state.

name: mg_b034_update_boss_hover_and_restore_bank6
summary: Runs the boss vertical hover animation and SFX update and restores UNROM PRG bank 6.

name: mg_b034_update_timed_explosions
summary: Advances up to 4 blast timers in 0x07DA, runs player hit checks, and expands blast tile clearing every 16 frames up to 0x40.

name: mg_b034_update_pattern_hazards_and_bank6
summary: Executes pattern-indexed room hazard updates and restores UNROM PRG bank 6.

name: mg_b034_update_random_hazards_and_bank6
summary: Executes pseudo-random room hazard updates and restores UNROM PRG bank 6.

name: mg_b034_update_hazard_and_palette_cycle
summary: Runs room hazard zone collision checks when active and queues a cycling 16-byte PPU palette write at 0x3F00 every 4 frames.

name: mg_b034_upload_bank00_ppu_stream_bb3a
summary: Points zero-page 0x80 to bank-0 PPU stream 0xBB3A and uploads two consecutive immediate nametable segments.

name: mg_b034_update_explosions_and_bank6
summary: Runs timed room explosion updates and restores UNROM PRG bank 6.

name: mg_b034_update_hazard_palette_and_bank6
summary: Runs hazard zone and palette-cycling updates and restores UNROM PRG bank 6.

name: mg_b034_bank03_advance_actor_sprite_state
summary: Increments the actor substate at zero-page 0xA8+slot and assigns sprite ID 0x31 for player action 0x11 or 0xCD otherwise.

name: mg_b034_bank03_tick_actor_anim_frames
summary: Decrements the actor animation timer in 0xB0+slot, updates sprite IDs at keyframe thresholds in 0xB8BD, and clears the sprite at 0xB0.

name: mg_b034_bank03_noop_stub
summary: Empty bank-3 subroutine stub that returns immediately.

name: mg_b034_pw_decode_byte_with_key
summary: Decodes an 8-bit password field by combining the low 5 bits of low_char with the shifted low 3 bits of key_char via XOR.

name: mg_b034_pw_decode_byte_bit4
summary: Decodes an 8-bit password field from bits 4..0 of low_char, bits 4..3 of mid_char, and bit 4 of high_char.

name: mg_b034_pw_decode_byte_bit3
summary: Decodes an 8-bit password field from bits 4..0 of low_char, bits 4..3 of mid_char, and bit 3 of high_char.

name: mg_b034_pw_queue_invalid_message
summary: Resets the VRAM write cursor and queues the invalid-password message from 0xBAAD into the 0x0740 buffer for PPU 0x216C.

name: mg_b034_pw_compute_checksum
summary: Sums the 24 password characters in zero-page 0xA8-0xBF with carry starting from seed 7 and returns the 5-bit checksum.

name: mg_b034_pw_commit_selected_char
summary: Saves the selected character index from 0xA7 into the current password slot at 0xA8+0xA6 and queues its tile at PPU address from 0xBBB3.

name: mg_b034_pw_clear_grid_cursor
summary: Queues a blank tile (0x00) at the current password grid cursor PPU address before moving the cursor.

name: mg_b034_pw_blink_grid_cursor
summary: Queues a blinking cursor tile (0x7C or 0x00 based on frame counter bits) at the password grid position indexed by 0xA7.

name: mg_b034_pw_pack_hi_bits_4_3
summary: Packs bit 7 of src_a and bit 7 of src_b into bits 4 and 3 of password buffer slot 0xA8+pw_slot.

name: mg_b034_pw_pack_upper_bits
summary: Packs bits 6..5 of src_a and bits 7..5 of src_b into password buffer slot 0xA8+pw_slot.

name: mg_b034_pw_pack_low5_bits
summary: Stores the lower 5 bits of value into password buffer slot 0xA8+pw_slot.

name: mg_b034_ppu_set_addr_zp90
summary: Writes the 16-bit PPU nametable address stored in zero-page 0x91 (high) and 0x90 (low) to PPU_ADDR.

name: mg_b034_ppu_draw_border_horiz
summary: Writes a corner tile followed by zero-page 0x92 horizontal border tiles (0x7B) to PPU_DATA.

name: mg_b034_ppu_draw_border_vert
summary: Writes a corner tile followed by zero-page 0x93 vertical border tiles (0x9E) to PPU_DATA.

name: mg_b034_ppu_set_vram_inc_32
summary: Sets the VRAM address increment-by-32 bit in g_ppu_ctrl_shadow and writes it to PPU_CTRL.

name: mg_b034_ppu_set_vram_inc_1
summary: Clears the VRAM address increment-by-32 bit in g_ppu_ctrl_shadow to select +1 mode and writes PPU_CTRL.

name: mg_b034_ppu_box_noop_stub
summary: Empty PPU box-drawing helper stub that returns immediately.

name: mg_b034_ppu_flush_vram_queue_from
summary: Processes queued VRAM transfer packets starting at queue_offset into PPU_ADDR and PPU_DATA until a zero terminator.

name: mg_b034_bank03_fade_palette_to_room_a5
summary: Steps through 4 palette fade frames via 0x0740 every 16 frames, transitions into room 0xA5 in mode 8, and restores bank 6.

name: mg_b034_bank03_dispatch_actor_state
summary: Dispatches a bank-3 actor slot via inline_jump_table_dispatch using its state byte at zero-page 0xA8+slot_idx.

name: mg_b034_pw_unpack_to_game_state
summary: Decodes the 24 password characters in 0xA8-0xBF into player rank, keycards, equipment, and progression flags in 0x6E-0x7F.

name: mg_b034_pw_dispatch_submode
summary: Dispatches the password entry screen phase via inline_jump_table_dispatch using g_game_submode.

name: mg_b034_pw_clear_screen_next_submode
summary: Calls the fixed-bank screen reset routine at 0xD3CF and increments g_game_submode.

name: mg_b034_pw_draw_char_grid
summary: Draws the 32-character password input grid directly to PPU nametable address 0x21E8.

name: mg_b034_pw_encode_from_game_state
summary: Encodes player rank, keycards, equipment, and progression flags in 0x6E-0x7F into 24 5-bit password slots at 0xA8-0xBF.

name: mg_b034_pw_draw_encoded_group
summary: Renders one 5-character encoded password group directly to PPU_DATA using character mapping table 0xBDC0.

name: mg_b034_ppu_draw_bordered_box
summary: Draws a framed rectangular UI box directly to PPU_DATA using dimensions and coordinates from table 0xBE6B.

name: mg_b034_ppu_flush_vram_queue
summary: Flushes all queued VRAM transfer commands starting from index 0 of 0x0740 to PPU_ADDR and PPU_DATA and resets the queue.

name: mg_b034_bank03_check_actor_player_hit
summary: Checks 8-pixel proximity between the player and actor slot_idx, decrementing health with SFX 0x2A on hit and updating actor state and sprite.

name: mg_b034_pw_play_enter_sfx_and_clear
summary: Plays password screen entry SFX 0x6D, resets the screen via 0xD3CF, and advances g_game_submode.

name: mg_b034_pw_init_entry_screen
summary: Blanks rendering, draws password UI boxes, header prompt, and character selection grid, re-enables NMI, and resets entry cursors.

name: mg_b034_pw_validate_input
summary: Unpacks the entered password, verifies its 5-bit checksum and field bounds, and triggers acceptance SFX 0x3A or error message with SFX 0x3B.

name: mg_b034_pw_wait_invalid_timer
summary: Counts down delay timer 0xA5 after an invalid password and returns to submode 0 via screen reset when it expires.

name: mg_b034_pw_wait_accept_and_start
summary: Counts down delay timer 0xA5 after an accepted password, plays SFX 0x85, clears the screen, and transitions to game mode 4.

name: mg_b034_pw_handle_grid_input
summary: Handles joypad-1 D-pad cursor movement across the 8x4 password grid and A-button character selection with sound effects.

name: mg_b034_pw_display_generated_password
summary: Encodes the active game state, computes its checksum into 0xC0, draws all 5 password groups, and enables NMI.

name: mg_b034_bank03_check_room_radio_triggers
summary: Checks g_room_id against event tables in 0xBF00 to initiate codec calls or blink transceiver alert bars in the VRAM queue.

name: mg_b034_pw_tick_entry_loop
summary: Runs one password input frame by polling grid input, blinking the cursor, and advancing g_game_submode when 25 characters are entered.

name: mg_b034_bank04_check_dir_spawn_bounds
summary: Compares scratch coordinates in zero-page 0x82-0x83 against directional screen bounds indexed by g_player_dir.

name: mg_b034_lookup_next_room_id
summary: Resolves the next g_room_id from room adjacency tables in 0x8A8E using direction index 0x39, or sets 0xFF for rooms 0x80-0xCF.

name: mg_b034_init_cutscene_player_sprite
summary: Initializes player sprite slot 0 with type 200 at coordinates (0x20, 0xC0) for the bank-4 ascent cutscene.

name: mg_b034_tick_ending_ascent_cutscene
summary: Ticks the 16-bit cutscene timer in 0x98-0x99, animates player sprite 200/201 rising upward, spawns trailing sprites, and resets submode on end.

name: mg_b034_reset_transceiver_cursor
summary: Resets the transceiver/warp state variable at 0x07C9 to zero.

name: mg_b034_arm_or_reset_transceiver_cursor
summary: Arms 0x07C9 to 0x80 if it currently equals 2, otherwise resets it to zero.

name: mg_b034_init_homing_projectile
summary: Sets projectile actor slot_idx sprite ID to 0x9C, initializes its step timer to 8, and advances its state in 0xA8+slot_idx.

name: mg_b034_step_homing_projectile
summary: Decrements projectile lifetime timer and moves its X/Y coordinates and sprite ID using directional velocity table 0xBCA7.

name: mg_b034_set_projectile_dir_sprite
summary: Assigns the directional projectile sprite ID from table 0xBCA7+0x0D to actor slot_idx.

name: mg_b034_calc_player_to_actor_delta
summary: Computes signed quadrant bits in 0xB0+slot_idx and absolute Y/X distances between the player and actor slot_idx.

name: mg_b034_dialog_advance_phase_and_reset
summary: Increments the dialog phase in 0x6B and resets g_dialog_menu_mode and g_status_bar_step to zero.

name: mg_b034_dialog_enter_text_mode
summary: Switches g_dialog_menu_mode to 1 (text streaming) and resets g_status_bar_step to zero.

name: mg_b034_dialog_clear_4_rows
summary: Queues one 20-byte blank dialog row into 0x0740 per frame using g_status_bar_step and enters text mode after 4 rows.

name: mg_b034_dialog_advance_clear_step
summary: Stores end_marker into 0x0758, advances g_status_bar_step, and enters dialog text mode at step 4.

name: mg_b034_dialog_enter_text_mode_if_zero
summary: Transitions g_dialog_menu_mode to 1 and resets g_status_bar_step when the CPU zero flag is set.

name: mg_b034_dialog_restore_bg_and_close
summary: Queues saved background tiles and attributes from 0x042C/0x0700 over 8 steps to erase the dialog window and closes dialog state on step 7.

name: mg_b034_spawn_room_actors_from_table
summary: Reads the spawn descriptor for g_room_id from 0x82CA, checks directional bounds, and populates enemy/object slots in 0x0308-0x0368.

name: mg_b034_check_special_room_dir_warp
summary: Dispatches directional warp logic via inline_jump_table_dispatch in rooms 0xDF and 0xE1, or clears 0x07C9 otherwise.

name: mg_b034_bank04_dispatch_actor_state
summary: Dispatches a bank-4 actor slot via inline_jump_table_dispatch using its state byte in 0xA8+slot_idx.

name: mg_b034_check_actor_proximity_trigger
summary: Computes player-to-actor distance and switches actor slot_idx to state 2 with timer 0x10 when within 33 pixels on both axes.

name: mg_b034_dialog_dispatch_phase
summary: Sets dialog active flag 0x4C to 1 and dispatches the current dialog phase in 0x6B via inline_jump_table_dispatch.

name: mg_b034_dialog_dispatch_speaker
summary: Dispatches dialog window layout or speaker variant in 0x48 via inline_jump_table_dispatch.

name: mg_b034_dialog_draw_box_frame_6step
summary: Queues 6 incremental VRAM packets from 0xBF87 to draw and attribute-mask the standard dialog box before advancing dialog phase.

name: mg_b034_dialog_draw_box_frame_8step
summary: Queues 8 incremental VRAM packets from 0xBF87 to draw and attribute-mask an alternate dialog box before advancing dialog phase.

name: mg_b034_dialog_tick_typewriter_and_prompt
summary: Drives codec/dialog text streaming across PRG banks 0, 1, and 5, blinks continuation sprite 0xC5, and handles button-advance timing.

name: mg_b034_dialog_clear_6_rows
summary: Queues one 16-byte blank row into 0x0740 per frame using g_status_bar_step and enters dialog text mode at step 6.

name: mg_b034_dialog_dispatch_close
summary: Dispatches dialog closing behavior in 0x48 via inline_jump_table_dispatch.

name: mg_b034_resolve_room_transition
summary: Evaluates special room warps and transition flags in 0x39 against bank-4 exit tables in 0x8A8E to update g_room_id.

name: mg_b034_tick_transceiver_cursor_warp
summary: Advances 0x07C9 state and decrements g_room_id with SFX 0x3A when bit 7 of 0x07C9 is set.

name: mg_b034_update_patrol_projectile
summary: Checks proximity to the player and, on odd frames, steps the actor along its scripted path in 0xBCA7 while updating its directional sprite.

name: mg_b034_dialog_reset_state_on_close
summary: Resets dialog phase and substate counters on close, playing SFX 0x31 when leaving cutscene substate 10.

name: mg_b034_tick_binoculars_room_peek
summary: Draws binoculars reticle sprite 0x3A, resolves directional room peek via 0x8120 on D-pad input, and restores the original room after 64 frames.
